title: coder: route all decision calls through a shared Decision Router client
body:
<!-- openagents-project-triage:start -->
## Project triage

Project: [Coder as Decision Router Consumer](https://github.com/orgs/OpenAgentsInc/projects/16) · Workstream: Decision integration · Priority: P1 · Readiness: Blocked.

Parent tracker: #9501.

Open prerequisites linked with native **blocked by** relationships: #9470, #9469.

Landed prerequisites retained as native dependency links: #9468.

The full profile matrix needs HTTP and the decision-specific relay/discovery lane; HTTP/local work can ship before relay. Reuse landed auth/receipt contracts (#9466/#9471), and co-develop reusable Rust client support with #9489. Completion of foreign-language SDK distribution is not a blocker.

<!-- openagents-project-triage:end -->

---

Replace provider-specific construction at Coder decision call sites with one Rust consumer abstraction over the public Decision API.

Specification: [one decision client](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/coder/coder-as-decision-router-consumer.md#one-decision-client). Consumer tracker: #9501. Service tracker: #9481.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Define validated profiles for hosted HTTP, direct local, own-provider, and relay decisions, separately from generation and executor configuration. Preserve existing environment compatibility with explicit precedence and diagnostics; malformed configuration must not disappear through .ok().
- [ ] Migrate turn action, shell outcome, program selection, independence, and completion through the same interface; avoid a parallel Coder-only inference backend.
- [ ] Preserve typed answers/outcomes, requested and actual artifact/execution identities, receipts, request/attempt IDs, cancellation, deadlines, bounded retries, and changed-content idempotency conflicts.
- [ ] Support local endpoints without a fabricated provider credential. An explicitly required router failure stops dependent execution; optional ordinary-chat degradation must be visible and must not widen authority.
- [ ] Keep direct local-only operation local, including review/fallback policy. Treat program-none, abstention, refusal, unavailable, quota exhaustion, and unknown completion as distinct.
- [ ] Verify terminal/headless parity and transport contract fixtures with fake/local services before bounded live runs. Relay decision jobs depend on #9469/#9470; existing generation/delegation jobs are not that contract.

- [ ] Revalidate dynamic tenant/model authorization at every program decision dispatch through the shared client, preserving requested identities and refusing revocation or changed access. The local program-effect grant from #9504 remains a separate prerequisite; it does not claim remote tenant authorization.

## Dependencies and boundaries

#9468, #9466, #9471, #9489; reuse landed tenancy/registry/quota work without claiming it already connects Coder.

Product code remains Rust; reuse the repository's shared contracts and manual/non-GitHub verification. This issue describes planned work, not implemented behavior.
